how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_033.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|foxablazeaqzl_wiki|foxablazeaqzl_wi:
A cheat-like support skill that enhances exploration and combat, exploiting the world as if bypassing normal limits.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Utility Suite: Grants full bright vision, Magicule flight, fall protection, entity highlighting, auto-eating, and automatic totem handling. Some effects consume Magicules continuously or when triggered.

Active
[Active - Press] Xray Hack: Highlights ores, making underground resources easier to find.

[Active - Press] Kill-Aura: With Mastery, automatically aims at nearby entities for attacks.

Opens a domain of negation, empowering the user while suppressing non-allied entities within it.

Active
[Active - Press] Domain: Negation Field: Opens a field of black blocks near the user. Inside the domain, the user gains Strength, Resistance, Speed, and Regeneration.

Non-allied entities are afflicted with Anti-Skill, Weakness, and Slowness, and take continuous damage while inside.

A divine general's authority centered on adaptation, gradually mastering, nullifying, and countering threats after enduring them.

Passive
[Passive] Adaption: After being hit by a damage type, the user gradually gains resistance, nullification, bypass, and degradation against that type. Being afflicted by an effect grants immunity to it. Severance and cook effects can also be adapted to and countered over repeated exposure.

[Passive - Toggle] Adaption Usage: Toggles all gained effect immunities.

[Passive - Toggle] Infinite Regen: Provides continuous regeneration.

[Passive] Learning: Increases skill learning and mastery progress.

Active
[Active - Press] Sword of Extermination: Summons or resummons the Sword of Extermination.

[Active - Press] List Filter: Opens a filter list, allowing the user to enable or disable gained effect immunities.

The authority of the God of Conquest, using guilt as a resource to summon weapons, unleash calamities, and dominate the world through four Aspects.

Passive
[Passive] Guilt: Slowly builds guilt, which is used as a resource for the skill's other abilities.

[Passive] Rend and Split: Damage from this skill is difficult to block or resist.

[True Passive] Aspect: Grants the Aspect system. Different Aspects change how Caedros conquers, including Control, Famine, War, and Death.

Active
[Active] Fang and Serpent: Checks and uses guilt to perform an attack.

[Active] Conquest: Summons an ashen halberd. While holding it, the user can dash and sweep; using the skill again charges the weapon, then blasts enemies away in a forward cone with heavy damage.

[Active] Plague and Pestilence: Sweeps the surrounding area twice. Recasting teleports to the target and strikes them with heavy status-effect damage.

[Active] BANG!: After winding up, releases a devastating line attack forward, blowing away or erasing targets and terrain while dealing void damage.

[Active] Construct: Sweeps the nearby area. Targets killed by this move become weapons orbiting the user; these weapons automatically attack nearby enemies and generate guilt when they break.

[Active] Cloud the Skies: Consumes all guilt and charges, turning the world red. During this state, enemies are debuffed and the user is empowered. Enemies killed by Caedros during this period lose all skills.

Aspect
[Aspect: Control] Opens a control GUI and locks selected skills. Targets far weaker than the user are forced out of their bodies into spirit form, adding their EP to the user temporarily.

[Aspect: Famine] Attacks apply stacking debuffs and steal enemy buffs. When debuffs exceed a threshold, Famine triggers, draining resources over time and spreading infection, hunger, and resistance shutdown across the world.

[Aspect: War] Increases damage based on the user's Magicules. Weaker targets become Conquered, losing skills and regeneration while giving part of their EP to the user. If all enemies are conquered, Total War begins, massively empowering the user and changing BANG!.

[Aspect: Death] Movement and damage scale with souls. Souls can revive the user. Those who die in the realm have souls stolen and leave behind perfect replicas that follow the user.

Disrupts the battlefield by swapping positions, allowing the user, enemies, projectiles, or marked targets to instantly exchange places.

Passive
[Passive] IQ of 530K: Grants Thought Acceleration, and can grant Sage with Mastery.

[Passive - Toggle] Passive Mastery: Provides passive mastery progression.

[Passive - In Slot] Tough Guy: Grants Resistance and Strength while slotted.

Active
[Active - Press] Exchange: Swaps the positions of two entities. Normally swaps the user with the target they are looking at; crouching swaps two random entities in range.

[Active - Press] Target Select: Enters target selection. Punching entities saves up to three targets; using it while holding a projectile can save the projectile as a target. Exchange prioritizes these saved targets. Crouching clears all saved targets.

The authority of reflected judgment, reflecting damage, storing it, and releasing it all at the moment of truth.

Passive
[Passive - In Slot / Toggle] Mirrored Reality: When taking damage, directly reflects part of it and stores the rest as Reflection for other abilities.

[Passive - In Slot] Fate Inversion: While Mirrored Reality is active, lethal damage is inverted, preventing immediate death and clearing stored reflections.

Active
[Active - Press] Glass Prophecy: Marks an enemy with Foretold. While marked, part of the damage taken by the user is stored on that target as Reflection.

[Active - Hold] Mirrorfield: Creates a mirror domain around the user, continuously damaging targets within it and storing Reflection from the damage dealt.

[Active - Press] Moment of Truth: Consumes all collected Reflection, dealing reflected judgment damage to the related targets at once and clearing the stored collection.

Locks the user's state into a greedy moment and sustains Little King through a pseudo heart.

Passive
[Passive] Little King: While a pseudo heart is placed on a nearby entity, the user's HP, Spiritual Health, Magicules, Aura, EP, and effects are locked to the state they were in.

[Passive - Toggle] Prevention: Limits how long Lionheart can be maintained, preventing its backlash from escalating too far.

[Passive] Damage Greed: Grants resistance degradation and immunity to severance and cook effects. Mastery strengthens the effect.

Active
[Active - Hold] Lionheart: After charging, saves the user's current state and locks the user in that state while held. Maintaining it too long causes severe backlash to the user.

[Active - Press] Little King: Places a pseudo heart onto the subordinate the user is looking at, enabling Little King. The subordinate must be alive and within effective range.

The authority of the Lord of Space, intercepting projectiles, crossing dimensions, compressing space into attacks, and creating prisons that isolate targets.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Spatial Interception Field: When toggled on, a spatial interception field surrounds the user. Incoming projectiles are frozen by distorted space before they can hit.

Active
[Active - Press] Dimensional Shift: After setting a target dimension, teleports the user to that dimension. When crouching, the user can specify a player and teleport to that player's location instead.

[Active - Press] Spatial Cube Barrage: Compresses space into cube-shaped projectiles and launches them forward. Crouching fires more cubes.

[Active - Press] Cube Judgement: Calls spatial judgment from above, causing falling spatial cubes to strike enemies in an area. Crouching calls down more cubes.

[Active - Press] Prison Realm: Creates a spatial prison that isolates or captures a target. The target is removed from normal space and confined in a separate prison. If the prison loses its master or is released, the target returns to normal space.

[Active - Press] End of All Creation: Spawns a massive black hole that drags in entities, projectiles, items, and falling blocks, repeatedly damages living targets, and ends in a crushing collapse.

[Active - Hold] Destiny Beam: Hold to charge a destiny beam. Higher charge increases damage, radius, and active duration. When released, the beam fires forward and can be swept across enemies while active.

Senses nearby Magic Ore and reveals its location through blocks.

Active
[Active - Press] Magic Ore Scan: Releases an expanding scan that highlights nearby Magic Ore and Deepslate Magic Ore through blocks. Without Mastery, the scan has a 12-block radius, lasts 8 seconds, costs 2,500 Magicules, and has a 12-second cooldown. With Mastery, the radius increases to 20 blocks, the duration increases to 16 seconds, the cost is reduced to 1,500 Magicules, and the cooldown is reduced to 6 seconds. Each successful activation grants 1 Mastery point.

A sacred white formula that commands holy ice, using parallel clones to assist with casting and gathering before annihilating enemies with spear rain, a frozen domain, and the final ice phoenix.

Active
[Active - Press] White Formula: Grand Choir: Summons 2 permanent parallel clones, increased to 3 with Mastery; press again to dismiss all clones. Clones assist with parallel spellcasting. They can also accept an item as a gathering order, search for ores, mine, collect dropped items, return to the user, and perform some hunting tasks. Crouch and press to transfer the user's consciousness into the nearest clone. The original body remains behind as an AI-less Anchor Body. Use the mode again to voluntarily return. If the controlled clone dies, the user is forcibly returned; if the Anchor Body is destroyed, the player dies immediately. A voluntary return restores the user to 75% HP. Returning after clone death restores only 45% HP and removes 12% of maximum Magicules and 12% of maximum Aura. Costs 80,000 Magicules, reduced to 60,000 with Mastery. Cooldown: 1 second, reduced to 0.5 seconds with Mastery.

[Active - Press] Tenth Formula: Ice Barrier: Creates a moving ice barrier that follows the user, periodically dealing Ice damage and knocking back nearby enemies. While maintained, Water and Ice magic deal 1.6x additional damage, increased to 2x with Mastery; all magic deals 1.4x additional damage, increased to 1.75x with Mastery; and Chant Speed gains an additional 2, increased to 3 with Mastery. While active, lethal damage automatically revives the user once per in-game day. Revival restores 75% HP, Magicules, Aura, and Spiritual Health, clears harmful effects, grants 6 seconds of invulnerability and 12 seconds of Self-Regeneration and Haki Armor, freezes and knocks back nearby enemies, places every mode on a 15-second cooldown, and grants a strengthening effect for 120 seconds. Costs 60,000 Magicules, reduced to 45,000 with Mastery.

[Active - Press] Second Formula: Stellar Ice Spear Rain: Hold to charge and release to summon a massive rain of ice spears at the targeted position. The spears descend in a spiral; each impact damages enemies within roughly 5 blocks and applies Diamond Dust. Enemies already affected by Frost take 55% additional damage. Costs 85,000 Magicules, reduced to 65,000 with Mastery. Cooldown: 2.5 seconds, reduced to 1.75 seconds with Mastery.

[Active - Hold] Seventh Formula: Frozen Cathedral: Hold to charge and release to unfold a massive Frozen Cathedral around the user. The domain continuously produces high-frequency ice-spike damage. Costs 160,000 Magicules, reduced to 120,000 with Mastery. Cooldown: 5 seconds, changed to 18 seconds with Mastery.

[Active - Hold] Ice Blossom Final Formula: Apocalyptic Ice Phoenix: Hold to charge and release to send an ice phoenix diving toward the targeted position, followed by an enormous area-wide ice explosion. Costs 260,000 Magicules, reduced to 200,000 with Mastery. Cooldown: 10 seconds, reduced to 7.5 seconds with Mastery.
